body.name: \mathfrak G_{K,T,H}(\rho_0)
body.construction: For fixed \(\rho_0\in(-r,r)\) and \(|h|\le H\), start from \(\Pi_{K,q_K(\rho_0+h/\sqrt{\lambda_K})}^{\mathrm{shell}}\), restrict its support further to \(\mathcal H_K(\rho_0,H+1)\), and expand jointly the score, collision count, and \(\widehat V_K\). Transfer the bounded loss \(\ell_T\) at fixed \(H,T\), then take \(K\to\infty\), followed by \(H\to\infty\), followed by \(T\to\infty\).
